name: switch
title: Switch
description: A setting that applies at once: a thumb that slides on a spring and stretches under the finger, with an optional label before or after.
whenToUse: Settings that take effect immediately when toggled.
notFor: Choices that apply only after Save (checkbox).

spec.motion: The thumb slides on --pui-ease-spring (no overshoot) and widens 4px while pressed. Toggled, the knob reaches toward its new side by the look's spread (--m-morph-spread; rigid looks keep their knob) and gathers there, never overshooting.

props.name: style / ref
props.description: Visual root style; ref targets native Radix switch button.

scopeDefaults.precedence: Instance prop, then nearest UIRoot.defaults entry, then existing component fallback. Only presentation keys are accepted; values, callbacks and operational state remain caller-owned.

spec.appearance: className/style address the visual root; classNames styles the documented parts. Internal measurement, keyboard and native ref wiring are preserved. 0.2: a labelled control now applies style to the labelled wrapper; classNames.control styles the native button.
